name: Agentic Coder
about: Questions about this repo, each with the function that answers it. The first 12 are the 29 Sep reranker bake-off's (models/evals/dev/experiments/rerank-bakeoff/code-labels.json; looksLikeEvent has since moved to facts.mjs); the other 13 were picked at random from terminal/src and models/runtime (29 Sep), and the question written after reading the function. find: a line the right piece must hold, for a function long enough to be read in several pieces.
